title: Korean basics
about: The most common words of written and spoken Korean (wordfreq counts, grouped by dictionary word with tools/course/ko/rank_ko.mjs), most common first, 50 to a unit. Names of people and places are left out. Particles (은/는, 을/를, 에 ...) count as words, as they do in Korean grammar; verb endings don't. Verbs and adjectives are given in their dictionary form (가다), and the sentence uses the form people say (가요). Each word has one short everyday sentence that uses it the way native speakers do, mostly in the polite 요 style, with its English translation; ⟦ ⟧ marks the part that translates the word.
